items.text: Approach the season/draft under normal course assumptions.
League to proceed with a set 75% threshold on games played.
A minimum of 8 games must be played to qualify as a legitimate season.
If a minimum of 8 games is played and the season is fully canceled due to COVID, the team in first place (record/points) at the time of the cancelation will be deemed the league champion.
A minimum of 8 games must be played to qualify as a year of service for any keeper.
If a keeper contracts COVID or opts out following the start of the season and the season achieves the 75% threshold, a year of service will be counted on the players contract.
If the 75% threshold is not achieved, previous keepers move up a round, but contract does not advance a year.

items.outcome: Voted 10-0 to implement a new rule of each team only having one “stack back”. All other normal course rules apply. To clarify, stack forwards are still allowed in all scenarios. Rule only applies when multiple players are being stacked backwards, pushing top talent to being kept in later rounds. In a trade scenario, the this would mimic the legacy rule, while implementing a cap of on keepers kept in a traded round.
